gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed glioblastoma (or gliosarcoma) at first or second recurrence

candidate_evidence.quote: I. To evaluate the anti-tumor activity of inducing hypothyroxinemic state by assessing progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS).
Patients receive methimazole orally (PO) daily and lomustine daily.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Inducing a Hypothyroxinemic State in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma or Gliosarcoma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: II. To evaluate the correlation of PFS and OS with thyroid hormone levels.
Patients receive liothyronine PO BID to maintain lower free T4 below lower limit of normal and TSH and free T3 in the normal range.

role_evidence.quote: This trial aims to see if giving a specific thyroid hormone, such as methimazole and liothyronine, is safe and could benefit cancer treatment.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Inducing a hypothyroxinemic state (lowered thyroid hormone) to produce anti-tumor activity

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive liothyronine PO BID to maintain lower free T4 below lower limit of normal and free T3 within normal range.

flag.reason: Liothyronine may be supportive (maintaining normal T3 while T4 is lowered) or part of the investigational hypothyroxinemic strategy; the record lists it with methimazole as the thyroid manipulation tested.

role_evidence.quote: Treatment with lomustine repeats every 6 weeks for up to 6 cycles or 12 months.

coder_notes: Phase is EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Single-arm; lomustine is given to all patients as the backbone on which the thyroid manipulation is tested and its own dose/schedule is not the question. Thyroid hormone levels are a systemic pharmacodynamic readout, not a tumour molecular biomarker, so no biomarker rows. Liothyronine role is uncertain (candidate vs supportive); the methimazole candidate keeps the trial eligible either way. Role of drugs differs by category (Category 2/3 patients receive no methimazole).
